 Hualien Indigenous Music Series Returns
 by Media OutReach November 16, 2026 in Press Release Reading Time: 4 mins read Share on Linkedin 
 Indigenous and International Stars Take the Stage Nov. 21-22 
 HUALIEN, TAIWAN – Media OutReach Newswire – 16 November 2026 – Following the enthusiastic response and wide acclaim for October’s K-POP x Indigenous Peoples Concert, the Hualien County Government is hosting the Hualien StarWave Indigenous Music Live this November, an event where music and Indigenous culture come together to shine their brightest! The full lineup for both nights has now been officially announced. The concerts will take place on two consecutive nights, Saturday, November 21, and Sunday, November 22, starting at 7 p.m. at Dongdamen Plaza in Hualien City. Bringing together legendary K-pop bands, popular boy groups, today’s hottest young idols and powerhouse local Indigenous singers, the event will also feature its own dedicated market. With electrifying musical energy and an unforgettable audiovisual experience, the concerts are set to draw music lovers and fans from all over Taiwan to Hualien.
 The 2026 StarWave Indigenous Music Live brings together legendary K-pop bands, popular boy groups, today’s hottest young idols and powerhouse local Indigenous singers. (Courtesy of the Department of Indigenous Peoples, Hualien County Government) The first night, Saturday, November 21, kicks off with a lineup of Golden Melody Award heavyweights and fresh young stars. Golden Melody Award Best Male Vocalist Nicky Lee will captivate the crowd with his warm, moving voice, while “Prince of Love Songs” Victor Wong will perform a selection of timeless classics for a romantic evening. Also taking the stage are Golden Melody Award-winning girl group GENBLUE, a favorite among young audiences; rising Korean boy group YOUNITE; Samuel Chou of the popular boy group Ozone; and the high-spirited Cosmic Angels, whose youthful stage presence will fill the opening night with energy.
 The second night, Sunday, November 22, takes the concert to its peak. Top Korean band FTISLAND and popular vocal star KIM SUNG KYU will make a high-profile appearance, delivering world-class performances. They are joined by Wayne Huang, a heartthrob known for both his variety-show charm and his strong vocals; ABUS, whose explosive voice carries the power of Indigenous music; and DJR, the powerhouse trio of DOHA, JIAHN and R1AN. With electronic and pop sounds blending across genres, the night promises to set the starry sky over Hualien’s Dongdamen ablaze.
 Beyond two consecutive nights of nonstop music, the event also features a dedicated on-site market, the Hualien Yuan WAVE · StarWave Market, created so that visitors traveling from across Taiwan and local residents can enjoy an even richer experience.
 The Hualien Yuan WAVE · StarWave Market will feature local Indigenous artisans, cultural and creative makers, and specialty food stalls. Blending traditional Indigenous craftsmanship with contemporary pop culture, the market lets visitors savor local delicacies and experience Hualien’s unique cultural depth and warmth while enjoying top-tier performances. The market perfectly captures the lively encounter and deep fusion of diverse music and local culture.
 The Hualien County Government stated that Hualien is home to rich natural landscapes and a deep Indigenous cultural heritage. Through the 2026 StarWave Indigenous Music Live, which combines international pop music with local Indigenous voices, the county hopes to create an international-caliber music brand unique to Hualien. The county hopes the event will be not only a celebration for music lovers but also a boost to tourism, hospitality and local industries, showcasing Hualien as a city full of energy and inclusiveness. Event information: the Hualien County Government Department of Indigenous Peoples Facebook page or the official event website .
